ConfigRequest.description: Request object for session configuration, supporting both initialization and runtime updates

description.description: A human-readable description of the session (optional; defaults to the name)

initiator.description: The name of the initiator (user or system); optional, defaults to anonymous

name.description: A human-readable name for the session

projectPath.description: The absolute root path of the project on the server's filesystem; optional, defaults to the current directory

sessionId.description: The unique session identifier used to track this context

tags.description: Metadata tags for categorization and filtering

workflows.description: A map of workflow definition requests keyed by workflow ID

sourcePort.description: Source port name (optional; omit to route all messages)
Source port name (optional; omit to route all messages)

field.description: The name of the field that failed validation

message.description: The validation error message explaining the failure

Node.description: A single node in the workflow DAG

group.description: The stage the node belongs to, for display only: the UI groups nodes of one stage. Without it, nodes group by node-ID prefix (before the first dot)

NodeCommandResponse.description: A node's answer to an administrative command

NodeRequest.description: A single node in the workflow DAG

Nodes.description: How far a run got through its nodes

failed.description: The first node that failed, if any

SessionDetails.description: Details of a session including metadata and workflows

tags.description: Tags associated with the session

SessionListItem.description: A session summary for list/table display

lastRun.description: The session's newest run, null when it has none

tags.description: Tags associated with the session

Warning.description: A problem that does not stop the workflow

field.description: The config field or output port it is about

WorkflowDefinition.description: Definition of a reactive workflow DAG

description.description: A human-readable description of the workflow

WorkflowDefinitionRequest.description: Definition of a reactive workflow DAG

description.description: A human-readable description of the workflow (optional; defaults to the workflow ID)

endTime.description: The end time of the execution, with the server's UTC offset

initiator.description: Who or what started the run (a name given at the start, or the key that started it), if known

nodes.description: How far the run got through its nodes

parentExecutionId.description: The run that started this one as a sub-workflow, if any

restartOf.description: The run this one restarts, if any

rootExecutionId.description: The top of this run's tree of runs (itself when it has no parent)

startTime.description: The start time of the execution, with the server's UTC offset

WorkflowGraph.description: A workflow DAG with plugin-enriched nodes for UI canvas rendering

topologicalOrder.description: Node identifiers in topological execution order

WorkflowGraphEdge.description: A directed edge between two workflow DAG nodes

sourcePort.description: The output port on the source node, null routes all messages

WorkflowGraphNode.description: A workflow DAG node enriched with plugin metadata for UI rendering

category.description: The plugin category, null if the plugin type is unknown

description.description: The plugin description, null if the plugin type is unknown

group.description: The stage the node declares it belongs to, null when it declares none

nodeId.description: The unique node identifier within the workflow

outputPorts.description: The config-aware output port names for this node

subWorkflowId.description: For a SUB_WORKFLOW node, the workflow it runs (its workflowId config), else null

type.description: The plugin type backing this node

uiDesign.description: The UI design metadata, null when the plugin provides none

WorkflowStartRequest.description: Request object for starting a workflow

initiator.description: Optional name of who or what starts the run; shown as the run's initiator. Defaults to the name of the API key.

payload.description: Optional trigger payload passed to the workflow's trigger node

WorkflowStartResponse.description: Response object for triggering a workflow

WorkflowStopResponse.description: Response object for stopping workflow executions

WorkflowSummary.description: Workflow summary with node/edge counts and execution status

edgeCount.description: Number of edges in the workflow DAG

nodeCount.description: Number of nodes in the workflow DAG

status.description: Latest execution status (PENDING, RUNNING, SUCCESS, FAILURE, ERROR), or null if the workflow has never been executed

WorkflowValidationResult.description: Result of validating a draft workflow without saving it

message.description: The first problem found; null when valid

outputPorts.description: Output ports per node id, for the node's configuration

valid.description: True when the workflow would be accepted

warnings.description: Problems that do not stop the workflow, for the editor to show

info.description: Create sessions and workflows, start and steer executions, and read their status, logs and results. Alpha: paths and schemas may change before v0.1.0.
info.title: Yukta REST API

get.description: idle is true once nothing runs or waits

post.description: Refuses new starts (HTTP 429) while running ones carry on. Poll GET until idle is true, then swap the server; DELETE admits starts again. Admin keys only.

get.description: Lists the nodes of all sessions that wait for a signal now, oldest first (at most limit, default 100, up to 1000), each with its session, execution, node, signal name and waiting-since.
Lists the newest control commands recorded in the execution log (applied or refused), with the actor that sent them
Lists the last heartbeat of every node of every run on the Control Bus, in one call
Lists all nodes currently registered on the Control Bus across all workflows
Lists all nodes in a specific workflow currently registered on the Control Bus

post.description: Sends an administrative command to a specific node in a workflow

additionalProperties.description: Command payload as a JSON object

schema.description: Command payload as a JSON object

post.summary: Send command to node in workflow

get.description: Retrieves the most recent heartbeat for a specific node in a workflow
Returns the edition of this build (COMMUNITY, PLUS or ENTERPRISE), its licence, the optional features it has and, where the licence asks for it, where the source is
Live node and workflow status changes, control command outcomes and log lines of all executions, each with a severity (INFO, WARN, ERROR)

parameters.description: With executionId, also the events of the sub-workflow runs it started, at any depth
parameters.name: tree

parameters.description: Only events of this severity or above: INFO, WARN or ERROR
parameters.name: severity

get.description: Lists the runs of all sessions (or of sessionId), newest first, narrowed by workflowId, status, text (in the execution id) and since/until (start time, ISO date-time). The history of each session is bounded by yukta.execution-log.retained-runs.

Across all sessions: runs RUNNING and QUEUED now, and runs with status FAILURE that started in the last `hours` (default 24). The history of each session is bounded by yukta.execution-log.retained-runs.
Pass sessionId to read a run older than the execution index from its session's history. Legacy path: /api/workflow/{sessionId}/status/{executionId} (deprecated)

parameters.description: Session ID, to read from the session's history
parameters.name: sessionId

delete.summary: Clear a breakpoint on a node

post.description: Pauses the node when the given payload field equals the given value, for example field=payload.status&equals=error

parameters.description: Field to compare, for example payload.status
parameters.name: field

post.summary: Set a breakpoint on a node

get.description: Returns numbered lines of what the node wrote: the tail, the head, a page (offset and limit, at most 500 lines) or only the lines matching a regular expression with context. Reports the total lines and bytes and whether lines were left out. 400 for a bad argument, 404 for an unknown execution or node.

parameters.description: Regular expression the lines must match
parameters.name: grep

parameters.description: Context lines either side of a match, at most 20
parameters.name: context

get.summary: Read part of the output of a node

post.description: Pauses a single node via backpressure. Legacy path: /api/workflow/{sessionId}/{executionId}/node/{nodeId}/pause (deprecated)
Resumes a single paused node. Legacy path: /api/workflow/{sessionId}/{executionId}/node/{nodeId}/resume (deprecated)
Restarts the execution from a node that failed. Returns the new execution.
Releases or rejects a node that waits for the named signal, for example a WAIT_FOR_SIGNAL approval step. Answers 409 if the node is not waiting for it.

parameters.description: Name of the signal the node waits for
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Decision, for example approve or reject
parameters.name: decision

parameters.description: Optional text that goes with the decision
parameters.name: data

post.summary: Send a signal to a waiting node

post.description: Marks a node as skipped (passthrough) or not. Core currently rejects this for running executions.. Legacy path: /api/workflow/{sessionId}/{executionId}/node/{nodeId}/skip (deprecated)

parameters.description: True to skip, false to unskip
parameters.name: skip

post.description: Lets exactly one element through a node in step-through mode. Legacy path: /api/workflow/{sessionId}/{executionId}/node/{nodeId}/step (deprecated)
Disables step-through debug mode on a node. Legacy path: /api/workflow/{sessionId}/{executionId}/node/{nodeId}/step/disable (deprecated)
post.summary: Disable step mode on a node

post.description: Enables step-through debug mode on a node. Legacy path: /api/workflow/{sessionId}/{executionId}/node/{nodeId}/step/enable (deprecated)
post.summary: Enable step mode on a node

parameters.description: True for hard stop, false for drain & stop
parameters.name: immediate

post.description: Pauses a specific workflow execution via global backpressure; with tree=true also every run it started as a sub-workflow. Legacy path: /api/workflow/{sessionId}/{executionId}/pause (deprecated)

parameters.description: Also every unfinished run the execution started as a sub-workflow, at any depth
parameters.name: tree

post.description: Rejected unless the execution is waiting for a slot
post.summary: Change the priority of a queued execution

post.description: Continues a run that a server restart aborted as a new run: nodes that finished are replayed from their recorded output, the rest run again. post.description: Starts the execution of a DAG workflow for a session. Answers 404 for an unknown session or workflow and 429 when the execution limit is reached.

get.description: Lists the executions of a session, newest first. A further page is announced in the X-Next-Cursor header. Narrow it with workflowId, status, text (text in the execution id) and since/until (start time range, ISO date-time).
Pass sessionId to read a run older than the execution index from its session's history. Legacy path: /api/workflow/{sessionId}/status/{executionId} (deprecated)

parameters.description: Session ID, to read from the session's history
parameters.name: sessionId

get.description: Streams progress via SSE. Legacy path: /api/workflow/{sessionId}/status/{executionId}/stream (deprecated)

parameters.description: Include historical status updates (last N minutes)
parameters.name: includeHistory

post.description: Pauses a single node via backpressure. Legacy path: /api/workflow/{sessionId}/{executionId}/node/{nodeId}/pause (deprecated)
Resumes a single paused node. Legacy path: /api/workflow/{sessionId}/{executionId}/node/{nodeId}/resume (deprecated)
Marks a node as skipped (passthrough) or not. Core currently rejects this for running executions.. Legacy path: /api/workflow/{sessionId}/{executionId}/node/{nodeId}/skip (deprecated)

parameters.description: True to skip, false to unskip
parameters.name: skip

post.description: Lets exactly one element through a node in step-through mode. Legacy path: /api/workflow/{sessionId}/{executionId}/node/{nodeId}/step (deprecated)
Disables step-through debug mode on a node. Legacy path: /api/workflow/{sessionId}/{executionId}/node/{nodeId}/step/disable (deprecated)
post.summary: Disable step mode on a node

post.description: Enables step-through debug mode on a node. Legacy path: /api/workflow/{sessionId}/{executionId}/node/{nodeId}/step/enable (deprecated)
post.summary: Enable step mode on a node

post.description: Stops a single node, immediately or after draining inflight work. Legacy path: /api/workflow/{sessionId}/{executionId}/node/{nodeId}/stop (deprecated)

parameters.description: True for hard stop, false for drain & stop
parameters.name: immediate

post.description: Pauses a specific workflow execution via global backpressure; with tree=true also every run it started as a sub-workflow. Legacy path: /api/workflow/{sessionId}/{executionId}/pause (deprecated)

parameters.description: Also every unfinished run the execution started as a sub-workflow, at any depth
parameters.name: tree

post.description: Continues a run that a server restart aborted as a new run: nodes that finished are replayed from their recorded output, the rest run again. Needs the file execution log and checkpoint directories. Answers 409 if the run was not aborted, was already resumed or its workflow changed.
Resumes a specific paused workflow execution; with tree=true also every run it started as a sub-workflow. Legacy path: /api/workflow/{sessionId}/{executionId}/resume (deprecated)

parameters.description: Also every unfinished run the execution started as a sub-workflow, at any depth
parameters.name: tree

post.description: Stops all active executions of a workflow and severs the trigger plugin input stream

parameters.description: DRAIN lets in-flight work finish (default), CANCEL cancels it, KILL stops at once
parameters.name: mode

post.description: Starts the workflow whose WEBHOOK_TRIGGER node has this path. 401 unless the body is signed with the node's secret; 404 for an unknown hook.
